why: The stable-lad says three of the sheep in the paddock have gone lame.
Holmes asks whether anything has been amiss 'of late', and the lad answers about that period.
A plain question raised by the lad's report and Holmes's pointed interest in it.

text: What lamed the sheep? — an epidemic or chance
why: The lad calls it 'not of much account', so an ordinary cause is a natural first guess. The label does not point at any particular answer.
